example_sentences: Di pikin-dem de ple fo yad.
notes: Plural: pikin-dem (IFRA §6.2). English-origin 'children' spellings map as variants only.

definitions: to be at a location; locative copula
notes: Tone pair: de (progressive) vs déy (locative). Variant 'dey' is unmarked tone; standard uses acute per SNO minimal marking.
IFRA reduplication/intensification: written together (§4.3–4.4). Naija Guru hyphenated form kept as variant for lookup.
